name: Puralis
tagline: Serious cleaning gear and know-how for people who do it themselves.
positioning: Puralis puts pro-grade degreasers, tools, and step-by-step cleaning playbooks in the hands of individuals — no service contract, no jargon.

hero.h1: Clean it like a pro. Without hiring one.
hero.sub: Puralis is the supply cabinet and manual behind serious industrial cleaning — grease, scale, grime, mildew — sized and explained for one determined person and a Saturday.

features.title: Job-matched kits
features.description: Tell us the surface and the mess — a rusted engine bay, a scaled water heater, a mildewed deck — and we ship the exact chemicals, dilution cups, and pads for it.

features.title: Step-by-step playbooks
features.description: Every kit ships with a plain-language, laminated procedure card. Dwell times, safety gear, disposal — no guessing, no ruined finishes.

features.title: Dilution that makes sense
features.description: Pre-measured concentrates and a calculator that converts a 55-gallon spec into a two-bucket job. Stop wasting product and stripping your surfaces.

features.title: Restock reminders
features.description: We track what you burn through and nudge you before the degreaser runs dry — right when the next quarterly deep-clean lands.

features.title: Safety, spelled out
features.description: Correct PPE, ventilation notes, and incompatibility warnings printed for the human in front of the fumes, not filed in a binder.

features.title: Real answers, fast
features.description: Message a certified cleaning tech a photo of the stain. Get a specific method back — usually within the hour, always in English.

testimonials.quote: I restore old motorcycles in my garage. Puralis figured out the exact solvent for baked-on chain grease and told me what NOT to spray near the paint. Saved me a repaint.
testimonials.name: Dario Fenwick

testimonials.quote: Our HOA pool deck had years of mildew. The kit and the playbook walked me through it in an afternoon — no contractor, no $900 invoice.
testimonials.name: Rosalind Meyer

testimonials.quote: I clean commercial kitchens as a side gig. The dilution calculator alone pays for itself. I stopped over-buying degreaser and my margins actually work now.
testimonials.name: Kenji Alarcon

pricing.blurb: For the occasional deep-clean. Buy kits as you need them.
For the person with a standing list of things to keep clean.
For the serious prosumer running near-commercial volume.

homepage.footerBlurb: Puralis. Pro-grade cleaning supplies and honest instructions for people who'd rather do it themselves — and do it right.
